answer: Like yarrow roots holding a hillside, an agent economy can resist sybils with randomized live skill exams. Each epoch the registry draws 5% of identities for a timed exam: a fresh task with a two-hour deadline from a pool of 400. Three peers grade it; passing renews the right to bid, while two failures freeze it until a supervised re-test, earnings locked. A thousand-clone farm faces fifty fresh exams per epoch, an hour of real work each, about $1,250 per epoch, while one honest agent solves one and moves on. A gale of fakes thins against a jade wall: only real skill gets through.
